scenario.topic: Pick a museum exhibit theme for the science center's summer program
scenario.opening_question: What balance of interactivity, educational depth, and budget should we aim for in the summer exhibit?

options.name: Renewable Energy Innovations Exhibit
options.upside: Showcases cutting-edge sustainable tech with hands-on demos
options.tradeoff: High setup time limits flexibility for last-minute changes
options.concern: May appeal less to younger children due to technical content
options.best_for: Visitors interested in current environmental technology

options.name: Space Exploration History Exhibit
options.upside: Engages broad age groups with iconic artifacts and multimedia
options.tradeoff: Less interactive stations may reduce hands-on engagement
options.concern: Some content may feel dated compared to newer space missions
options.best_for: Families and general audiences seeking inspiring stories

options.name: Human Brain and Neuroscience Exhibit
options.upside: Offers immersive experiences on brain function and cognition
options.tradeoff: Complex topics might require more staff explanation
options.concern: Could overwhelm casual visitors unfamiliar with neuroscience
options.best_for: Visitors interested in biology and psychology

options.name: Robotics and Artificial Intelligence Exhibit
options.upside: Highly interactive with live robot demos and AI challenges
options.tradeoff: Max budget use leaves little room for additional marketing
options.concern: Technical glitches could disrupt visitor experience

shared_context: The science center has a budget of $50,000 for the summer exhibit
